about: Course thumbnails for docs/Course_Catalogue_Website.xlsx (Course Master (2) record IDs). Each image in public/Thumbnail Samples is named after an LMS course and its printed title was checked against the course. An image is used only where its printed name, type, learning model and language do not contradict the course. Courses without a confirmed image keep the placeholder. Build: python3 scripts/build-course-thumbnails.py
